description: This is a utility class named Exec that provides methods to execute shell commands, manage their process streams, handle timeouts, and retrieve command output as strings or streams. It includes logging, timeout handling, and process management functions.

classes.name: Exec
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to run shell commands, manage subprocess streams, apply timeouts, and handle command output.

methods.name: runForStream
methods.description: Executes a shell command, returning its output stream, with timeout handling and callbacks for cancellation and exceptions.

methods.name: runForStrings
methods.description: Runs a shell command and collects its output into an array of strings, with timeout handling and callback mechanisms.
